sn45.162:1.3: “seyyo hamasmī”ti vidhā, “sadiso hamasmī”ti vidhā, “hīno hamasmī”ti vidhā.
sn45.162:1.5: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ vidhānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya …pe… pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.162:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti …pe… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.162:1.8: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ vidhānaṃ abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya …pe… parikkhāya …pe… pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
